goals.label: Wealth
goals.description: Cash, savings, shares and what your belongings are worth, minus unpaid rent. Clothes count for nothing, appliances for a little, property and a business for a lot.

goals.label: Happiness
goals.description: How content you are, averaged with how you felt a week ago. A good mood has to last.

goals.label: Education
goals.description: Degrees and diplomas earned, however you earned them, plus what you have taught yourself.

goals.label: Career
goals.description: How far you have got at work: the job you hold, how settled you are in it, and the raises you have earned there.
goals.score: jobCareer() * (params.careerBase + (1 - params.careerBase) * min(1, weeksInJob() / params.careerTenureWeeks)) + raises() * params.seniorityCareer
